🟠 [kv-regex-class] MUST-FIX scripts/check-backlog-entries.js:131 — the `kv` regex character class `' `?([^`\\n]+)`? '` resolves to `[^`\<n>]` (not backtick, not backslash, not literal `n`) instead of `[^`\n]` (not backtick, not newline). Concrete impact: every supplied config with `n`/`\`/backtick in a value fails to parse — e.g. the shipped default `.claude/backlog-config.md` sets `mode: warn` and `allowlist_path: .claude/backlog-debt.json`, both of which contain `n`; the script silently keeps the built-in default (`mode:'warn'`, `allowlist_path:null`), so a future config that tries to flip `mode: block` will be ignored with no diagnostic. Smallest remediation: change the inner regular-string fragment to `' `?([^`\n]+)`? '` (let `\n` be the actual newline) in both `scripts/check-backlog-entries.js` and `platforms/codex/plugin/scripts/check-backlog-entries.js`.
🟠 [assert-not-contains-undeclared] MUST-FIX hooks/tests/check-backlog-entries.test.sh:175 — the ratchet "removed fixed code" assertion calls `assert_not_contains`, but the spec explicitly enumerates only `assert_eq` and `assert_contains` as the test helpers sourced from `lib.sh`. Concrete impact: if lib.sh does not already define that helper, the suite aborts at the ratchet step and `bash hooks/tests/check-backlog-entries.test.sh` fails the "verification you must leave green" gate. Smallest remediation: either add `assert_not_contains` to `hooks/tests/lib.sh` (mirror of `assert_contains` with inverted grep status) or rewrite that single assertion using `! assert_contains "$(cat "$al")" "missing_field" "removed fixed code"` semantics via `grep -q` and `assert_eq`.
